Legge solo i record pubblici del nome in: It reads only the public records of the name entered: it does not attempt zone transfers (AXFR) or subdomain discovery.
SPF e DMARC sono letti dai record TXT; D: SPF and DMARC are read from the TXT records; DKIM cannot be checked without knowing the selector used by the sender.
Il WHOIS usa RDAP (HTTPS) e, se non disp: WHOIS uses RDAP (HTTPS) and, if unavailable, the registry's WHOIS service on port 43: some registries show little data for privacy reasons.
Gli indirizzi non pubblici (reti private: Any non-public addresses (private networks, loopback) found in the records are not shown.
Qualsiasi server al mondo è autorizzato: Every server in the world is authorised to send mail on behalf of the domain: the SPF offers no protection.
Non dice cosa fare con i server non elen: It does not say what to do with unlisted servers: almost no protection against spoofing.
I messaggi non autorizzati vengono solo: Unauthorised messages are only marked: acceptable if DMARC has a strict policy, otherwise -all is better.
Manca il meccanismo «all» finale: i serv: The final "all" mechanism is missing: unlisted servers stay in a neutral state.
Il record richiede {n} interrogazioni DN: The record requires {n} DNS queries: above 10 the check fails (RFC 7208) and the SPF becomes ineffective.
Nessun indirizzo IP per il nome: No IP address for the name
Mancano i record A e AAAA: il nome non p: There are no A or AAAA records: the name does not point to a web server. This may be intentional (a mail-only domain) or a configuration mistake.
{n} indirizzi di reti private o riservat: {n} private or reserved network addresses are published in the records: they reveal information about the internal network (they are not shown here).
Pubblica gli indirizzi interni solo nel: Publish internal addresses only in the internal DNS (split-horizon).
Ci sono record MX ma nessun record TXT «: There are MX records but no "v=spf1" TXT record: anyone can impersonate the domain more easily (spoofing).
Pubblica un record SPF che elenchi i ser: Publish an SPF record listing the authorised servers and ending with -all or ~all.
Nessun record DMARC su {host}: chi ricev: No DMARC record on {host}: recipients do not know how to handle forged messages.
Aggiungi un record TXT su _dmarc con pol: Add a TXT record on _dmarc with a p=quarantine or p=reject policy (you can start with p=none to collect reports).
La policy raccoglie i report ma non chie: The policy collects reports but does not ask for forged messages to be quarantined or rejected.
Con un solo NS, se quel server non rispo: With only one NS, if that server stops responding the domain disappears from the Internet. Good practice (RFC 2182) calls for at least two name servers on different networks.
Dedotto dal record CNAME: gli indirizzi: Inferred from the CNAME record: the IP addresses belong to the CDN, not to the origin server.
Nessun problema rilevato nei controlli e: No problems found in the checks performed.
Lettura passiva dei record DNS pubblici,: Passive reading of public DNS records, with SPF and DMARC checks and recognition of DNS and CDN providers.
